Description.Value:
NEW CAMPAIGN ONLY: the spider joins the STARTING squad, so begin a new campaign with this mod on.
A spider downloaded off a model site joins the starting squad as a real unit, keeping its own 49-bone skeleton and playing its own clips (Spider_Walk, Spider_Idle, Spider_Idle_long, Spider_Damage, Spider_Attack_1, Spider_Attack_2, Spider_Death) through Phoenix Point's own animation machinery. The model is 'Cyborg Spider' by SpiderBight [ArachnoBoy], licensed CC BY 4.0 - attribution required, and it is kept here and in SOURCES.md. It clones a shipped non-humanoid unit and repoints two defs: AddonsManagerDef.Rig (the mesh and skeleton) and TacActorAnimActionsDef (which clip plays for walking, shooting and dying). Requires the ContentTool mod.
The baked bundle SHIPS with the download, so nothing has to be built first: measured 2026-08-28 with no bake command ever run, the creature spawned into a live mission, bashed a target 190 -> 130, spat it 130 -> 120, walked 3.98 tile/s and played its own death clip - the full 19-arm check passed. 'ct_project CustomCreature' is the AUTHOR's command, for rebuilding Dist\CustomCreature.bundle after editing the model or ppcontent.json; a player never needs it. Read README.md - it teaches the wiring.
